responsibility: This file implements mc’s command-line and output-configuration handling. It parses argv, selects the target output language by calling decl’s language setters, records search paths and preprocessing settings, controls verbosity and internal debugging, stores code-generation toggles such as extended opaque handling, GCC config/system includes, scaffolding, bool usage, and noreturn suppression, and emits optional GPL/header comment text. It is the central repository of user-selected compilation options for the mc tool.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation of mcOptions, containing the stored option state, help/version text, command-line matching, output-language selection, and startup defaults. The sibling mcOptions.def only exposes those services to the rest of mc.
